name: Morioka Hinako
source:
She grew up in an ordinary family and has a normal personality. Although she is somewhat laid-back and marches to the beat of her own drum, her actions are filled with kindness and consideration. While she has a few quirks, the maternal warmth she radiates evokes the image of a mother that captivates Asato's heart.

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041023222235/http://www.bishoge.jp/scoop/products/museum/yuwaku.htm]ScooP archived page[/url]]
